title: Finding what was needed
literal_meaning: The lost ox turns up where one looked.
explanation: The source applies this to finding something needed unexpectedly. The pleasure lies in the search meeting its object.
meaning_odia: ଦରକାର ଥିବା ଜିନିଷଟି ହଠାତ୍ ମିଳିଗଲେ ଏହି କଥା କୁହାଯାଏ।
usage_example: Looking through an old folder, someone finds the missing document. (Original editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
